latin_text: Since it is divided into principalities, archangels, and angels, all the activity of these is concerned only with what is under the moon; that of the principalities with states and kings and princes, as we learn from Daniel, that of the archangels with mysteries and holy ceremonies; the angels are busy with private affairs and are assigned to men individually.
english_translation: Since it is divided into principalities, archangels, and angels, all the activity of these is concerned only with what is under the moon; that of the principalities with states and kings and princes, as we learn from Daniel, that of the archangels with mysteries and holy ceremonies; the angels are busy with private affairs and are assigned to men individually.
exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico maps the lowest angelic triad to specific earthly functions: Principalities govern states, kingdoms, and princes (Danielic authority—Dan. 10:13, 20); Archangels oversee sacred mysteries and rites; Angels attend to individual human affairs and serve as guardian spirits. [VERIFIED] This establishes universal angelic governance at every scale: from empires to ceremonies to personal souls.

The philosophical function is practical-mystical: understanding one's relationship to this hierarchy explains one's spiritual position. The human soul has an individual guardian angel; human religious practice participates in archangelic mysteries; human political order reflects principalities' governance. [INFERRED] Ascending means aligning progressively with higher orders: from individual guidance to participation in mysteries to communion with princes of realms.

[VERIFIED] Oration (O.1.15) invokes the three archangels (Raphael, Gabriel, Michael) as guides through the three philosophical disciplines. Being & Unity grounds it: participated being operates at every level of human and cosmic existence.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.TE3.C3.3 | Celestial governance hierarchy: principalities, archangels, angels
